kes.name: Kes Vane
kes.title: The Ashen Kestrel
kes.style: Fastest hero. Shreds single targets and heals by striking, but has the least health.
kes.blurb: A courier from Greyhollow, quick with a blade and quicker on his feet. His little sister walked into the ash at the last toll.

passive.name: Bloodletter
passive.desc: Basic attacks heal you for 2.5% of the damage they deal.

skills.name: Feather Step
skills.desc: Dash forward, cutting every enemy you pass through.

skills.name: Talon Strike
skills.desc: Lunge at the nearest enemy and drive both blades in. Always a critical hit.

skills.name: Whirling Ash
skills.desc: Spin for 1.4s, slicing all around you. You can move while spinning.

ult.name: Hundred Cuts
ult.desc: Blink 8 times between nearby enemies, three strikes each time. On a lone foe, every strike lands on it. You cannot be hit.

brannoc.name: Brannoc
brannoc.title: The Iron Oath
brannoc.style: Toughest hero. Slow, huge swings that stun.
brannoc.blurb: An old soldier of fallen Lumenhold who has walked the roads for seven years. He knows the voice of that bell. He left its keeper behind.

skills.name: Oathbreaker
skills.desc: Leap to the nearest enemy and slam the ground, stunning everything nearby.

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.desc: For 4s take 35% less damage and reflect 30% of it back. Heals 8% HP.

skills.name: Chain of Penance
skills.desc: Hurl a chain that drags enemies in a line toward you.

ult.name: Fall of Lumenhold
ult.desc: Three crushing shockwaves roll out from you.

odalys.name: Odalys Fen
odalys.title: The Ash-Witch
odalys.style: Glass cannon. Fire magic from range, big area damage.
odalys.blurb: Once an acolyte of the hill chapel, cast out for listening to the ash. Now the ash is singing with the bell, and she alone can hear the words.

skills.name: Cinder Nova
skills.desc: Burst of fire around you that hurls enemies back.

skills.name: Pyre Line
skills.desc: Draw a line of fire that burns for 3s.

skills.name: Ashen Orbs
skills.desc: Three burning orbs circle you for 6s.

ult.name: Falling Star
ult.desc: Call down a burning star on the largest group of enemies.

hale.name: Hale Morrow
hale.title: Warden of the Ashwood
hale.style: Agile archer. Keeps her distance, traps and volleys.
hale.blurb: The last hunter of the Ashwood. Last night she saw the forest's ancient stag walking toward the bell with fire in its eyes.

skills.name: Tumble Shot
skills.desc: Roll backwards and loose three arrows.

skills.name: Thorn Snare
skills.desc: Plant a trap that roots enemies in place and pierces them.

skills.name: Rain of Thorns
skills.desc: Arrows fall on the nearest group of enemies.

ult.name: Heartwood Gale
ult.desc: A piercing gale-arrow that blasts through everything in a line.
